no-comments: No comments anywhere; WHY-knowledge goes to docs/context/code-notes.md or an ADR.
zod-strict-boundary: Boundary z.object() must chain .strict() so unknown keys are rejected.
structured-logging: Log a static message plus a metadata object; never interpolate values.
no-log-and-throw: A catch block logs XOR throws — never both, or the error is reported twice.
test-file-location: Tests are *.test.ts(x) colocated; no *.spec.ts or __tests__/ folders.
no-internal-vi-mock: Mock only at system boundaries; inject internal dependencies instead.
no-server-date-formatting: Server emits ISO-8601 UTC; locale formatting lives in the client layer.
require-datetime-zod: Boundary dates are z.string().datetime({ offset: true }), never z.date().
no-naive-date-parse: Parse only ISO strings; no Date.parse() or new Date(nonIso).
boundary-schema-location: Define request-input z.object() schemas in *.schema.ts (route/API surface) so strict/datetime rules apply.
no-raw-error-at-boundary: Throw AppError families from lib/errors.ts at boundaries, never a raw built-in Error.
route-exports-only-handlers: route.ts exports only HTTP handlers and Next route config; logic lives in lib/.
no-deep-module-import: Import a module by its public entry, never by reaching into its internal files.
filename-convention: Source file names are kebab-case; Next.js special files already comply and dynamic [param] segments are exempt.
declarations-at-top: Constants, type aliases, interfaces and enums are declared at the top of the file, before any function or class implementation.
single-type-per-file: A file declares at most one top-level interface, type alias, or class; each gets its own file (grouped Zod *.schema.ts files exempt).
filename-role-suffix: Every source file states its role in its name (.component.tsx, .interface.ts, .type.ts, .class.ts, .enum.ts, .schema.ts, .hook.ts, .service.ts); framework-reserved and test files are exempt.
kind-folder: Interface, type, class and enum files live in a kind-named folder within their directory — interfaces/, types/, classes/, enums/.
